answer: The settlement contract bonds each agent key with 150 tokens for 120 days. If fraud proofs convict k keys in one 24-hour window, it burns 5%×k of every bond, capped at 100%. Windows follow block height, not a quartz clock the attacker controls, and k is public. A locked bond can't back a second key. Fakes rigging lotus oil bids must act at once, so they fall together in one plume of proofs, and the k-th fake adds 7.5×(2k−1) tokens of loss.
